title: Live runtime terminal stories must be excluded from tests
answers: How do I write a Storybook story that boots the real terminal VM?
Why is tags: ['!test'] on LiveDoom/LiveClassics stories?
body:
Stories that boot the real v86 guest (LiveDoom, LiveClassics in frontend/src/scenes/terminal/TerminalScene.stories.tsx) use:
- tags: ['!test'] so they are skipped by the snapshot/test runner
- parameters: { liveRuntime: true }
- a play function that waits for terminalLogic.values.status === 'ready' with a long timeout (120_000), then calls window.posthogTerminal?.write('<cmd>\n').
Follow this pattern for any new live-command story.
applies: Terminal Storybook stories that need the live guest runtime
